It sounds incredibly exhausting to have the fear of death constantly overshadowing your life and keeping you from the things you enjoy. When these intrusive thoughts take over, it can be helpful to practice grounding techniques to bring your focus back to the present moment. Try focusing on your immediate senses—what you can see, hear, or feel right now—to gently guide your mind away from the "what ifs" and back to the present activity. 

Since these thoughts are controlling your entire life, reaching out to a mental health professional could be incredibly beneficial. Therapies like Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) are specifically designed to help you identify, challenge, and reframe irrational fears so they lose their power over you. You deserve to live fully and enjoy your life, and with the right support and tools, it is absolutely possible to quiet these thoughts and reclaim your joy.
